note: MIN STANDARD. Latch VALUES only. A pointer, [read*], n/a, UNASSIGNED, or a 'verified' stamp is a label — not a value. Task = full wish text. Crew window/tps/MAX = numbers. Timestamp = ISO. Agent = Family | Clade | Version. Context source = absolute existing paths (openable). If you cannot check the cell without following a link, it is empty.

example.Task: FIRST read docs/AGENT_BRIEF.md and docs/AGENT_BOUNDARIES.md. P10: PROPOSE only. Never write the live tree. WISH: AUTO-RESESSION — continue across the context boundary, zero / minimal user disturbance.
example.Target & scope: proposals under Output only; never kernel/ledger/sched/service; never LiT; never grok.exe

types.Context source: list of absolute existing file paths (openable; not [read*] labels)
types.Task: FIRST read AGENT_BRIEF + BOUNDARIES; then full wish verbatim
types.Timestamp: ISO-8601 with offset (product field, not PREFIX)
types.MAX_tokens: positive int = window-(cache+prompts)-0.20*window; ceiling 0.8*window if cache+prompt 0
types.crew: exactly 3 objects; mix paid-low vs :free; each Agent three-part; each has context_window_tokens, cache_floor_tokens, cache_ttl, cache_prefix, timeout_s, tps, pack, tier
